answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 9245 Country: India Title: Please let me know, if I touch breast of my wife physically after wudu (ablution),it will invalidate my wudu or not. Question: Please let me know, if I touch breast of my wife physically after wudu (ablution),it will invalidate my wudu or not. Answer ID: 9245 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Accoridng to the Hanafi Fiqh, the wudhu does not break by doing so. But, if there was discharge of pre-seminal fluid ( mazi ) then the wudhu will break. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
